component.name: DiskLens
磁盘透镜
component.summary: Explore disk usage, installed apps, large files and user caches
查看磁盘占用、已安装软件与大文件，清理用户缓存

description.p: DiskLens is a local Qt desktop application for Ubuntu. Inspect filesystem usage, browse DEB, Snap and Flatpak packages, find large files and review user cache and log cleanup.
磁盘透镜是一款面向 Ubuntu 的本地 Qt 桌面应用，提供文件系统空间统计、DEB / Snap / Flatpak 软件查看、大文件扫描以及用户缓存和日志清理。

Switch between English and Simplified Chinese and adjust the font size in the application. Documentation is available in both languages. Package removal requires a preview and confirmation; cache cleanup requires selecting and confirming scanned entries.
应用内可切换简体中文与英文，并调整字体大小。文档提供独立中英文版本。软件卸载需预览并确认，缓存清理需勾选并确认扫描条目。
Combine directory hierarchy and allocated-space bars in one expandable view, with per-parent percentages and explicit incomplete measurements.
将目录层级与实际占用进度条合并，在展开各层目录时直接查看大小与父目录占比，并明确标注不完整统计。
Keep sibling entries visible in bounded space analysis, show pending measurements, and add Home folder and parent-scope navigation.
修复空间分析遗漏同级项目，显示待统计状态，新增主目录入口与跨范围上一级导航。
Refreshed workspace, responsive overview cards, clearer large-font tables, coalesced search, icon caching, pixel scrolling and keyboard navigation.
更新工作区界面、自适应首页卡片及大字号表格，优化搜索、图标缓存、像素滚动与键盘导航。
Switchable English and Chinese interface, persistent font sizing, and separate release documentation.
Interactive directory analysis, complete SHA-256 duplicate detection, developer workspace classification and application storage attribution.
Multi-version Ubuntu builds for x86_64 and ARM64, refreshed icons and bilingual project documentation.
